verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is API-first. Scraping, JS scenarios, extraction, proxies, screenshots and the dedicated search, ecommerce and AI APIs are all exposed as API parameters or endpoints, and a Usage API exposes account credit and concurrency data. However, nothing documents an explicit API/UI parity guarantee or API coverage of dashboard functions, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, API access to dashboard functions such as key management, billing and plan settings, API (not just CLI) access to schedules, and a published OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
